customer_id.meaning: primary id of the beneficiary record (one record per DEERS-enrolled person: sponsor or family member)

name.meaning: beneficiary full name exactly as shown in DEERS

dbn.meaning: DoD Benefits Number printed on the uniformed services ID card, unique per person; an identity credential

date_of_birth.meaning: beneficiary date of birth as recorded in DEERS; an identity credential and the basis of every age rule

sponsor_ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the sponsor's Social Security number (the sponsor's own for a sponsor); an identity credential

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on file; an identity credential and lookup key

email.meaning: email address on file; an identity credential and lookup key

residence_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the residential address in DEERS; an identity credential

mailing_address.meaning: residential mailing address as recorded in DEERS

residence_service_area.meaning: Prime Service Area containing the DEERS residential address; non_psa means the address lies outside every Prime Service Area of the West Region

sponsor_customer_id.meaning: beneficiary record of the sponsor whose service gives this person eligibility; equals customer_id for the sponsor; the family grouping key for family deductibles, fees and catastrophic caps

relationship_to_sponsor.meaning: relationship to the sponsor as recorded in DEERS

beneficiary_category.meaning: current DEERS beneficiary category; the authoritative eligibility fact behind every plan tier

sponsor_pay_grade.meaning: sponsor's current pay grade in DEERS (retired grade for retirees); drives pay-grade based cost shares

sponsor_initial_entry_date.meaning: date the sponsor first entered uniformed service; before 2018-01-01 places the family in Group A, on or after places it in Group B

medicare_part_b_status.meaning: Medicare entitlement status reported to DEERS

life_event_id.meaning: primary id of the DEERS life-event record

customer_id.meaning: beneficiary whose eligibility the event changed (foreign key -> customers)

event_kind.meaning: kind of qualifying life event recorded in DEERS

event_date.meaning: date the life event occurred as recorded in DEERS; the anchor of qualifying-life-event windows and the effective date of QLE enrollments

deers_recorded_date.meaning: date the event was entered in DEERS (at an ID card office or by the uniformed service); later than or equal to event_date

provider_id.meaning: primary id of the provider or facility record

provider_name.meaning: provider, practice or facility name as listed in the TRICARE West provider directory

provider_kind.meaning: network relationship: military hospital or clinic, TRICARE network primary care, network specialist, network facility or supplier, non-network provider that accepts assignment on the claim (participating) or one that does not (nonparticipating)

service_area.meaning: Prime Service Area where the provider's practice location is; non_psa when outside every Prime Service Area

panel_status.meaning: whether a primary care provider is accepting new Prime enrollees; not_a_pcm for specialists, facilities and suppliers

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the verification record (one per beneficiary)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; never goes back from true to false

verified_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by the system clock
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by the system clock

prime_enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the Prime enrollment

values: TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member
TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member
TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member
TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member
variant_name.meaning: Prime tier held, as its official full name

enrollment_effective_date.meaning: date Prime coverage starts (DEERS qualifying-life-event date, January 1 after open season, or the eligibility date for automatic enrollment)

disenrollment_date.meaning: last day of Prime coverage; empty while applied or active

enrollment_reason.meaning: basis on which the enrollment was made

qualifying_life_event_id.meaning: DEERS life-event record a QLE enrollment relies on (foreign key -> deers_life_events); empty otherwise

application_date.meaning: date the enrollment application was received

fee_bearing.meaning: true when this enrollment carries the sponsor family's Prime enrollment-fee billing

fee_coverage_type.meaning: fee level billed to the family: individual (one Prime enrollee), family (two or more), not_applicable for fee-exempt tiers or non-fee-bearing enrollments

payment_frequency.meaning: installment frequency elected for the enrollment fee

payment_method.meaning: payment method elected for the enrollment fee

fee_balance_due.meaning: current enrollment fees owed; identically the sum of the enrollment_fee_due deltas on the fee ledger; negative is a credit owed to the beneficiary

ohi_on_file.meaning: whether other health insurance is on file for the enrollee

prime_fee_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the fee ledger entry

customer_id.meaning: beneficiary holding the fee-bearing enrollment (foreign key -> customers)

coverage_period_start.meaning: first day of the coverage period an installment covers (its due date), or first credited month for a credit; empty on payments and refunds

coverage_period_end.meaning: last day of the coverage period an installment covers or of the credited span; empty on payments and refunds

installment_frequency.meaning: frequency of the installment charged; not_applicable on payments, credits and refunds

amount.meaning: amount of the entry, always positive; the event type fixes the direction

payment_method.meaning: method used for a payment or refund; not_applicable on charges and credits

adjustment_reason.meaning: credit-eligible reason on a credit; not_applicable otherwise

related_fee_entry_id.meaning: entry this one settles or adjusts: the installment charge a payment or credit applies to, or the credit a refund pays out; empty on charges

pcm_assignment_id.meaning: primary id of the PCM assignment or waiver record

provider_id.meaning: PCM assigned or covered by the waiver (foreign key -> providers)

effective_date.meaning: date the assignment takes effect, or the date the waiver was signed

assignment_reason.meaning: why the assignment was made; not_applicable on waiver rows

access_waiver_signed.meaning: whether a signed access-standard waiver covers this PCM

prime_claim_line_id.meaning: primary id of the adjudicated claim line or reversal

prime_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment the care was billed under (foreign key -> prime_enrollments)

claim_number.meaning: claim number as printed on the TRICARE Explanation of Benefits, e.g. WB26-0412-55810

service_date.meaning: date of service of the line

service_class.meaning: benefit class the line was adjudicated under

referral_authorization_id.meaning: referral or authorization covering the line (foreign key -> referral_authorizations); empty when none

pos_applied.meaning: whether point-of-service charges were applied to the line

allowed_amount.meaning: TRICARE allowed amount for the line

ohi_paid_amount.meaning: amount other health insurance paid first; 0.00 when none

pos_deductible_applied.meaning: portion of the cost share applied to the point-of-service deductible; 0.00 when none

cost_share_amount.meaning: beneficiary cost share on the line (positive); on a reversal, the cost share withdrawn

posted_date.meaning: date the line or reversal was adjudicated

reversed_claim_line_id.meaning: on a reversal, the adjudicated line it reverses (foreign key -> prime_claim_lines); empty on postings

reversal_reason.meaning: reason for a reversal; not_applicable on postings

prime_request_id.meaning: primary id of the Prime request intake record

customer_id.meaning: beneficiary the request is for (foreign key -> customers)

prime_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment the request concerns (foreign key -> prime_enrollments)

requested_provider_id.meaning: military clinic requested as PCM (foreign key -> providers); empty for disenrollment requests

requested_effective_date.meaning: effective date the beneficiary asked for

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by the system clock

select_enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the Select enrollment

values: TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4)
TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above)
TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4)
TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above)

coverage_period_start.meaning: first day of the period an installment covers (its due date), or first credited month for a credit; empty on payments and refunds

coverage_period_end.meaning: last day of the period an installment covers or of the credited span; empty on payments and refunds

installment_frequency.meaning: frequency of the installment charged; not_applicable on other entries

amount.meaning: amount of the entry, always positive; the event type fixes the direction

payment_method.meaning: method used for a payment or refund; not_applicable on charges and credits

adjustment_reason.meaning: credit-eligible reason on a credit; not_applicable otherwise

related_fee_entry_id.meaning: entry this one settles or adjusts: the installment a payment or credit applies to, or the credit a refund pays out; empty on charges

select_claim_line_id.meaning: primary id of the adjudicated claim line or reversal

select_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment the care was billed under (foreign key -> select_enrollments)

claim_number.meaning: claim number as printed on the TRICARE Explanation of Benefits, e.g. WB26-0731-20417

service_date.meaning: date of service; the admission date for an inpatient stay; decides the plan year the line accumulates to

claim_received_date.meaning: date the claim was received by the region; empty on reversals

provider_id.meaning: rendering provider or facility (foreign key -> providers)

provider_network_status.meaning: network relationship of the provider on the service date as adjudicated

service_class.meaning: benefit class the line was adjudicated under

inpatient_days.meaning: covered inpatient days on an inpatient facility line; 0 on outpatient lines

prior_authorization_id.meaning: approved authorization covering the line (foreign key -> referral_authorizations); empty when none

ohi_paid_amount.meaning: amount other health insurance paid first; 0.00 when none

deductible_applied.meaning: part of the line applied to the deductible; 0.00 when none; on a reversal the deductible withdrawn

cost_share_amount.meaning: total beneficiary liability on the line (deductible plus cost share or copayment), never including balance billing above the allowed amount; on a reversal the liability withdrawn

tricare_paid_amount.meaning: amount TRICARE paid on the line; on a reversal the payment withdrawn

line_outcome.meaning: adjudication outcome of a posted line; not_applicable on reversals

reversed_claim_line_id.meaning: on a reversal, the adjudicated line it reverses (foreign key -> select_claim_lines); empty on postings

reversal_reason.meaning: reason for a reversal; not_applicable on postings

select_request_id.meaning: primary id of the Select request intake record

customer_id.meaning: beneficiary the request is for (foreign key -> customers)

select_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment the request concerns (foreign key -> select_enrollments)

requested_effective_date.meaning: effective date the beneficiary asked for

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by the system clock

premium_enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the premium-based plan purchase

variant_name.meaning: plan and coverage type held, as its official full name

coverage_effective_date.meaning: date coverage starts (DEERS qualifying-life-event date or January 1 after open season)

termination_date.meaning: last day of coverage; empty while applied or active

qualifying_life_event_id.meaning: DEERS life-event record the purchase or the latest coverage-type change relies on (foreign key -> deers_life_events); empty otherwise

application_date.meaning: date the purchase application was received

premium_balance_due.meaning: current premiums owed; identically the sum of premium_due deltas on the premium ledger; negative is a credit owed to the purchaser

coverage_type_change_date.meaning: date the latest coverage-type change took effect; empty when none

ohi_on_file.meaning: whether other health insurance is on file for the purchaser

premium_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the premium ledger entry

coverage_month.meaning: coverage month a bill or credit applies to; empty on payments and refunds

due_date.meaning: date a bill is due (last calendar day of the month before the coverage month; the application date for initial-payment bills); empty on other entries

billing_kind.meaning: kind of bill; not_applicable on payments, credits and refunds

coverage_days.meaning: days of the coverage month a bill or credit covers; equals the days in the month for whole-month entries; 0 on payments and refunds

amount.meaning: amount of the entry, always positive; the event type fixes the direction

payment_method.meaning: method used for a payment or refund; not_applicable on bills and credits

adjustment_reason.meaning: reason for a credit; not_applicable otherwise

related_premium_entry_id.meaning: entry this one settles or adjusts: the bill a payment or credit applies to, or the credit a refund pays out; empty on bills

premium_claim_line_id.meaning: primary id of the adjudicated claim line or reversal

premium_enrollment_id.meaning: plan the care was billed under (foreign key -> premium_plan_enrollments)

claim_number.meaning: claim number as printed on the TRICARE Explanation of Benefits

service_date.meaning: date of service; decides the plan year the line accumulates to

service_class.meaning: benefit class the line was adjudicated under

cost_share_key.meaning: cost-share key the line was priced under

deductible_applied.meaning: part of the line applied to the deductible; on a reversal the deductible withdrawn

cost_share_amount.meaning: total beneficiary liability on the line; on a reversal the liability withdrawn

reversed_claim_line_id.meaning: on a reversal, the line it reverses (foreign key -> premium_claim_lines); empty on postings

reversal_reason.meaning: reason for a reversal; not_applicable on postings

premium_request_id.meaning: primary id of the premium-plan request intake record

premium_enrollment_id.meaning: plan the request concerns (foreign key -> premium_plan_enrollments)

requested_effective_date.meaning: termination date the purchaser asked for

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by the system clock

referral_authorization_id.meaning: primary id of the referral or authorization

variant_name.meaning: authorization type, as its official full name

referral_number.meaning: reference number printed on the referral or authorization letter, e.g. WRA-2026-0418-337

requesting_provider_id.meaning: PCM or treating provider who requested it (foreign key -> providers)

servicing_provider_id.meaning: provider or facility currently authorized to deliver the care (foreign key -> providers)

coverage_plan.meaning: plan the patient's care was covered under when the request was made

units_requested.meaning: units the requesting provider asked for, in the tier's unit of measure

information_requested_date.meaning: date clinical information was requested from the requesting provider; empty when never pended

decision_date.meaning: date of the latest approval or denial decision; empty while undecided

denial_reason.meaning: reason for a denial; not_applicable unless denied

valid_from.meaning: first day of the validity span; empty until approved

valid_through.meaning: last day of the validity span (inclusive); empty until approved; moves out with extensions

units_authorized.meaning: units authorized on approval (extensions are recorded on the unit ledger)

units_remaining.meaning: units not yet used or released; identically the sum of the authorized_units deltas on the unit ledger

servicing_change_reason.meaning: reason for the latest servicing-provider change; not_applicable when never changed

servicing_change_date.meaning: date the latest servicing-provider change took effect; empty when never changed

closed_date.meaning: date the authorization was cancelled, expired or exhausted; empty otherwise

referral_unit_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the unit ledger entry

units.meaning: units granted, added, used or released; always positive, the event type fixes the direction

grant_basis.meaning: basis of a grant; not_applicable on other entries

extension_sequence.meaning: 1 for the first extension, 2 for the second and so on; 0 on other entries

extended_valid_through.meaning: new last day of the validity span set by an extension; empty on other entries

service_date.meaning: date of service of a use; empty on other entries

claim_number.meaning: claim number of the claim line a use comes from; empty on other entries

line_number.meaning: line number of the claim line a use comes from; 0 on other entries

release_reason.meaning: reason units were released; not_applicable on other entries

referral_request_id.meaning: primary id of the referral request intake record

referral_authorization_id.meaning: authorization the request concerns (foreign key -> referral_authorizations)

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by the system clock

appeal_case_id.meaning: primary id of the appeal, review or grievance case

customer_id.meaning: beneficiary the determination or complaint concerns (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: case tier, as its official full name

appeal_reference.meaning: case reference printed on the acknowledgment letter, e.g. WAP-26-104422; empty until acknowledged

representative_appointment_on_file.meaning: whether an appointment of representative is on file for a third-party filer; false for filings by the beneficiary or a parent or guardian

subject_kind.meaning: kind of initial determination or matter the case is about

subject_plan.meaning: plan the subject record belongs to; not_applicable for authorization denials and service complaints

subject_claim_line_id.meaning: adjudicated claim line appealed (foreign key -> prime_claim_lines, select_claim_lines or premium_claim_lines per subject_plan); empty unless subject_kind is claim_line or allowable_charge

subject_claim_number.meaning: claim number of the appealed line as printed on the Explanation of Benefits; empty otherwise

subject_referral_authorization_id.meaning: denied authorization appealed (foreign key -> referral_authorizations); empty unless subject_kind is authorization_denial

subject_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment or plan ended for nonpayment (foreign key -> prime_enrollments, select_enrollments or premium_plan_enrollments per subject_plan); empty unless subject_kind is enrollment_disenrollment

initial_determination_date.meaning: date of the determination appealed, copied from the subject record (claim line posted_date, authorization decision_date, enrollment disenrollment_date or termination_date); the date of the event for a grievance

filing_date.meaning: date the case was received by the region

amount_in_dispute.meaning: amount at issue under the tier's amount_in_dispute_basis; 0.00 where not applicable

acknowledgment_date.meaning: date of the acknowledgment letter; empty until acknowledged

decision_date.meaning: date of the decision, dismissal or withdrawal; empty while open

dismissal_reason.meaning: reason for a dismissal; not_applicable unless dismissed

escalation_date.meaning: date the next-level request was received; empty unless escalated

appeal_document_id.meaning: primary id of the case document record

customer_id.meaning: beneficiary the case concerns (foreign key -> customers)

document_kind.meaning: kind of document received or requested

received_date.meaning: date the document was received, or the date the records request was sent

submitted_by.meaning: who sent the document; region_reviewer on records requests

appeal_request_id.meaning: primary id of the appeal request intake record

appeal_case_id.meaning: case the request concerns (foreign key -> appeal_cases)
